comparison.objective: Bend a copper tube to 90 degrees while compensating for springback.
comparison.physical_skill: Operate a lever bender past the target and relax it to achieve a precise permanent bend.
comparison.success_condition: Relaxed tube measures 87–93 degrees, lever returned, grippers clear, stable 1 s; over-bending beyond 96 degrees fails.
comparison.reason: Controlled plastic deformation and springback compensation are unrelated to granular separation. No material rubric detail is missing.
